Technical Product Manager – Developer Platform & APIs
Stratus Cloud · Hyderabad, India (Hybrid) or Remote within India

Stratus Cloud provides cloud infrastructure to 20,000 businesses. Our Developer Platform team builds the public APIs, SDKs and developer portal used by our customers' engineering teams. We are hiring a Technical Product Manager to lead the API platform.

What you'll do
- Own the roadmap for our public REST APIs, SDKs and developer documentation.
- Work with engineering architects to make decisions on API design, versioning, authentication and rate limiting.
- Write detailed technical requirements and API specifications (OpenAPI).
- Measure developer experience using metrics such as time to first API call and API error rates.
- Talk to customers' developers to understand their needs and pain points.
- Coordinate releases across multiple engineering teams.

Requirements
- 7+ years of experience, including at least 4 years as a product manager for technical or platform products.
- A computer science or engineering background, or equivalent hands-on software development experience.
- Deep understanding of REST APIs, authentication (OAuth 2.0) and cloud architecture.
- Experience writing technical specifications and working closely with engineering teams.
- Strong data skills; SQL required.

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with developer tools, SDKs or API management platforms.
- Knowledge of Kubernetes or major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).
- Experience with usage-based pricing for APIs.

Candidates must be able to own outcomes end to end and drive alignment across the organisation.

We offer a competitive package, a cloud certification budget and flexible hours. Stratus Cloud is an equal opportunity employer.
